summary: Willis Lease Finance Corp filed an 8-K to report entry into an underwriting agreement and indenture for a $200M issuance of 2.50% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031, with a $30M over-allotment option. The notes were sold under an existing S-3 shelf registration via an underwritten public offering. No change of control, acquisition, divestiture, or corporate restructuring is involved. This is a standard debt capital markets transaction and does not constitute a special situation.
